title: Forever, Framed
subtitle: Wedding Photography & Films
description: From the first haldi to the last dance, our wedding photography and cinematic wedding films are built to hold every emotion your big day carries. Candid wedding photography, drone coverage, same-day edits, and full-length wedding films — designed to feel like your story, not a template.

title: Before the Vows
subtitle: Pre-Wedding Shoots
description: Every love story deserves a chapter before the wedding itself. Our pre-wedding shoot photography takes you to locations that match your story — from mountains to old havelis to your own backyard — captured with a cinematic, editorial eye.

title: Business, Beautifully Told
subtitle: Corporate Event Coverage
description: Product launches, conferences, brand anniversaries, corporate offsites — our corporate event photography and videography team captures the energy of your brand's biggest moments with the same precision we bring to a wedding.

title: Roots, Remembered
subtitle: Cultural & Community Celebrations
description: Festivals, community gatherings, religious ceremonies, cultural celebrations — we specialize in capturing tradition with respect and warmth, so heritage is never lost, only preserved on film.

title: Every Detail, Handled
subtitle: Full Event Management
description: Beyond photography and films, House of Echoes offers complete event management services — vendor coordination, venue planning, décor liaison, and on-ground execution — so you experience your event instead of managing it.
